m.english: Once they get to the market, trouble begins.

target.text: Quando chegam ao mercado, o problema começa.

translation.text: Once they get to the market, trouble begins.

m.english: The strong always rise to the top. That's always been the case with any species.

target.text: Os fortes chegam ao topo, sempre foi assim em qualquer espécie.

translation.text: The strong always rise to the top. That's always been the case with any species.

m.english: That's how they get to be cliches.

m.english: The military won't even go in there.

m.english: No windows in a casino, so the morning never comes.

target.text: Não há janelas num casino, por isso as manhãs nunca chegam.

u.english: Make sure my folks get home all right.

target.text: Vê se os meus pais chegam bem a casa.
